coverage.assessment: Three argument steps lose their support: the colliding-molecule premise for Unity=Multiplicity, modern science's failure for the Aquinas comparison, and the bomb as a form of denying unity. The '17,750,000' figure and the 'automobile in Paris' joke were cut together, as the plan permits. A small dangling residue remains: 'since 1879'.
The Inverlochy, Paris and Hitt's attic chain is clear. Adams, 'the student' and 'the historian' stay traceable. 'He could not stop there' still resolves to the drag-net and dilemma.

Both speeches are performed and correctly attributed. However, the narrator's reason for preferring the Virgin is altered. An internal splice in her speech also drops 'our interest is only in man' (first draft).

Key hedges survive: 'unless one mistook the meaning of motion', 'if one understood it right', 'as far as a superficial student could follow'. Pascal is attributed, IvXn is glossed, and sixty-five is consistent with sixty-three in 030.

The added framing, 'In his imagination' and 'In the student's imagined colloquy', prevents the speeches being read as historical quotation. The ironic distance stays intact, and nothing is disclosed prematurely.

The epigrams survive. Several deflating self-portraits are lost, including the ignorant old man and Death as vis a tergo, and 'Adams cared little whether he escaped'. This flattens the narrator's mockery somewhat.
The unity/multiplicity spine is intact. The dissolving-mind turn and the scale-law conclusion survive. The thinned links (gas collisions, the Aquinas comparison) weaken the dialectic at its pivot.
The Dynamo/Virgin naming is intact at both ends. The two-points passage is present in full, word-for-word against the preface quotation. The preface itself (001) is omitted, as planned.

findings.claim: The revision cuts the collision clause and 'Granting this ocean of colliding atoms'. No molecule in the draft now collides; they merely fly 'in right lines'. Yet the next paragraph concludes 'Thus' that synthesis equals the analysis called Multiplicity.
findings.counterevidence: 'All forms being shifting phases of motion' partly implies the point. Cutting the figure together with the joke is authorized.

molecules of gas, flying in right lines. To this analysis--if one understood it right--all matter whatever was reducible.

findings.title: Kinetic gas loses its collisions, making Unity=Multiplicity abrupt

findings.claim: The first draft cut 'unless the denial took the form of a bomb'. As a result, the later 'anarchist bomb bade one go on' lacks its link to denying unity. The revision also cut the hinge 'supposing society to be ignored, the philosopher was no further forward'. 'Nihilism had no bottom' now follows the social-punishment sentence as a non sequitur.
findings.counterevidence: Readers may infer anarchism equals denial of unity, and the bomb line remains vivid on its own.

strengths: All eight verbatim lines survive exactly, including the chiasmus 'the drift found the seeker' and the acrobat image as the paragraph's closing deflation.
The imagined-speech markers ('In his imagination', 'In the student's imagined colloquy') satisfy the continuity check. Both speeches stay performed in full voice.
The revision restores 'without assuming anything as true or untrue, except relation' and 'studied at once in philosophy and mechanics', making the two-points passage complete.
The bicycle-rider-to-acrobat sequence keeps its escalating logic: dispersion or orientation, then sanity as unstable artifice.
The gas number and the automobile-in-Paris joke are cut together, avoiding an orphaned punchline.
summary: The revision hits all twelve essential beats. It keeps all eight verbatim lines, marks the Virgin and Aquinas speeches as imagined, attributes Pascal, states the age as sixty-five, and preserves the two-points passage intact. Most problems come from revision-stage cuts to connective reasoning. The kinetic gas loses its collisions, so the turn from Unity to Multiplicity becomes abrupt (the plan's flagged risk). The claim that Aquinas is more scientific loses its grounds. The Virgin's greater conviction gets a changed reason. The bomb and the logical step into nihilism are weakened. The self-mocking asides are also thinned. These are editorial repairs, not blockers.
